[[File:JoganFruit-EP.png|thumb|right|200px|A jogan fruit]]
'''Jogan fruit''' was a round, edible [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] with [[Color/Legends|purple]] skin featuring wavy white stripes and orange inner juices. They were topped with small wine-red leaves; round green leaves were sometimes present on the sides of the fruit. It was an ingredient in [[Jogan fruitcake/Legends|jogan fruitcake]]. The fruit is widespread through the galaxy from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. It was also found in the swamps of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].

==History==
[[File:JoganFruits-EP.png|thumb|left|200px|A canister of jogan fruit]]
During a banquet hosted by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] honoring Senator [[Aang/Legends|Aang]] jogan fruitcake was served for dessert. Since the dish was a favorite of Senator Aang's it was vital to have it properly prepared. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] had failed to acquire the fruit prior to the event, so the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] accompanied him to ensure the last-minute purchase was successful. They returned just in time with four jogan fruit for the cake.

Vendors like [[Droogan/Legends|Droogan]] sold the fruit on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in open market stands. Though the fruit was displayed for view it was purchased in containers.

==Culinary Use==
[[Jogan fruitcake/Legends|Jogan fruitcake]] was a pastry whose main ingredient was the eponymous fruit. Whole jogan fruit were prominently featured atop the cake.
